subject: Air freight quote to NRT
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote the cheapest air freight option to NRT (Tokyo, JP), including truck pickup from our site at postcode 45715 (Essen), Germany, and transport to the departure airport?

The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-27. It consists of 5 pieces of precision instruments, with a gross weight of 324 kg and a total volume of 2.60 cbm.

Please send us your all-in price in EUR, including the pickup.

Thank you.

Viele Gruesse / Many greetings
Deniz Yilmaz
Rheintal Elektronik GmbH
